Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules, some of which appear to have cavitation or irregular margins. In the context of chest pain and non-productive cough, this presentation is highly characteristic of Necrotizing Sarcoid Granulomatosis (NSG), a rare variant of sarcoidosis distinguished by necrotizing granulomas and vasculitis that often manifest as cavitary nodules on imaging.
